page.title: Knowledge
page.description: Give Toskar your own files and data, such as catalogs, price lists, policies, and notes, so its answers use them. For each question, Toskar finds the passages that match and answers from them, and shows the source. Edit a file and the next question sees the change.
page.emptyDescription: Connect a file or folder on this computer, paste content, or read from a database or web API. PDF, Excel, CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, Markdown, text, and HTML files work.

connect.title: Connect your files or data
connect.body: A file or folder on this computer, pasted text, a database, or a web API. Toskar reads it in place and keeps up with changes.

use.title: Choose which profiles use it
use.body: Add it to a profile, such as {{profile}}. Chats with that profile look in it before answering.

ask.title: Ask in Chat
ask.body: Toskar answers from the passages that match your question and lists the source under the reply.

catalog.title: A price list or catalog
catalog.body: A spreadsheet or CSV of products, prices, and stock.

policies.title: Policies and manuals
policies.body: PDFs and documents your answers should follow.

notes.title: A notes folder
notes.body: Markdown or text notes, kept up to date as you edit them.

database.title: A database
database.body: Orders, customers, or inventory, read-only, one row per passage.

api.title: A web API
api.body: Live data such as stock levels, fetched again when it gets old.

meaning.full: Searchable by meaning, not only by matching words.
meaning.partial: Searchable by meaning: {{embedded}} of {{total}} passages so far.

refresh.note: Fetched again when a question uses it and the data is more than {{every}} old, or on Reindex.

row.watches: Reindexes itself when the files change.
row.localOnlyHint: Never send passages from this source to a paired computer. Chats that use it run here.
row.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{name}}? Profiles and AIs that use it stop seeing it. Your files are not deleted.
row.saveHint: Saving reindexes the source. Chats and specialized AIs see the change on their next question.
row.unused: No profile uses this yet, so Chat doesn't look in it.

add.title: Connect knowledge
add.pathHint: Toskar reads it in place and picks up edits automatically.
add.name: Name (optional)
add.useWithHint: Chats with these profiles look in this source before answering. You can change this later on Profiles.

remote.connectionHint: Use an account that can only read. It is stored apart from the database and not shown again.
remote.queryHint: One SELECT. It runs read-only, so Toskar never changes the database. Each row becomes a passage.
remote.urlHint: JSON, CSV, or text. A list of objects becomes one passage per item.
remote.name: Name (optional)

search.title: Try a question
search.description: See which passages a question would bring into the chat.
search.question: Question

picker.pathPlaceholder: Or a file or folder, like ~/Documents/catalog
picker.manage: Manage sources, edit pasted content, and try searches on the <go>Knowledge</go> page.

languages.crossNote: This source is in {{source}}. Questions in {{yours}} find it by meaning once a multilingual embedding model, such as BGE-M3, is installed from the Models page; until then, by matching words.
